meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: Claude 能把一个 DAG 定义存成命名 JSON 文件,之后按名字直接重跑,不必每次粘贴定义。保存时写入库目录,加载时会轮换 key,让每次调用都成为新的一次运行,也可指定后缀复用旧运行。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或反复调度同一个多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 把这个 DAG 存成 nightly-audit,然后跑一次。
帮我运行已保存的 nightly-audit。
say.note: 默认轮换 key,得到一次全新运行。
key 固定,复用同一次逻辑运行。

howto.what_en: Claude stores a DAG definition as a named JSON file in a library dir and reruns it by name, instead of pasting the definition each time. On load it rotates the key so calls start fresh; an explicit suffix can reuse a run.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

say_en.text: Save this DAG as nightly-audit, then run it once.

say_en.note: Default rotation gives a fresh run.
Fixed key reuses that logical run.
